name: Silt Amber

themes.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no modifications. Warm dark luxury palette: #1a1a18 near-black page background, #f2f2f2 off-white text, #b1ada7 warm greige muted text.

Replaced all three proprietary fonts with Google Fonts: Grenette → Playfair Display (high-contrast editorial serif), Times → Lora (classical body serif), Graphik → DM Sans (geometric UI sans). Applied optical size scaling: h1 letter-spacing to -2.4px, h2 to -1.8px, body line-height opened to 1.65, nav gains uppercase with 0.08em tracking.

Deceleration Dominance: All easing curves replaced with pure deceleration variants (ease-out family only). Three @keyframes introduced: fadeSlideUp (0.7s), scaleReveal (1.1s), staggerFade (0.3s). Duration scale: micro 0.05s → cinematic 1.1s.
Asymmetric Column Weighting: 12-column base grid with explicit asymmetric templates — 5fr/7fr (text-left) and 7fr/5fr (UI-left). 24px gutter, 48px margin, 1280px max container.
Generous Breathing Room: All spatial values scaled by 1.3× for ultra-airy editorial territory. Section gap: 213px, container top padding: 348px, row top margin: 398px, outer margins: 317px.

Asymmetric Elastic Easing: Buttons enter fast (0.18s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)) and exit slow (0.4s ease-out). Links use slow-out hover (0.45s) and snap-back active (0.12s). Inputs get named property transitions with differentiated durations.

Sticky split-wing layout: centered logo with nav items flanking left/right. Height condenses from 72px to 52px on scroll. Frosted glass backdrop-filter activates on scroll. Font consistency-fixed from Inter to DM Sans.

Typography section shifted from analytical-descriptive to kinetic register — framing the scale contrast as tension held taut. concept_by_video.md generated as cinematic motion brief with 3 video placements: hero-bg.mp4, product-feature.mp4, manifesto-ambient.mp4.

consistencyChecks.checkA_colorContrast: PASS — navText #000000 vs transparent pageBackground #f2f2f2 → sufficient contrast. bodyText #000000 vs pageBackground #f2f2f2 → sufficient contrast.
consistencyChecks.checkB_motionInteraction: PASS — hover durations (0.18s–0.45s) vs motion standard (0.3s) → max ratio ~1.5×, within 5× threshold.
consistencyChecks.checkC_navFont: FIXED — nav.json fontFamily 'Inter' not present in assembled type system. Replaced with 'DM Sans' (covers nav role in typeScale.nav).

aestheticRegister: Warm-dark luxury editorial with asymmetric tension. Material warmth from caspers-caviar palette (organic near-blacks #1a1a18–#3d3a34). Editorial serif display (Playfair Display) over classical body (Lora) over UI sans (DM Sans). Languid settling motion — nothing snaps. Ultra-generous spacing signals luxury restraint. Split-wing nav condenses with frosted glass on scroll.
